name: replaces names and keeps punctuation
input: two names in an ordinary sentence
test: assert redact_document('Ask Alice, then Bob.', ['Alice','Bob'], ['[NAME]','[NAME]']) == 'Ask [NAME], then [NAME].'

name: chooses the longest phrase at a position
test: assert redact_document('Visit New York or New Jersey.', ['New','New York'], ['N','NY']) == 'Visit NY or N Jersey.'

name: does not reprocess inserted replacement text
test: assert redact_document('Alice met Bob.', ['Alice','Bob'], ['Bob','X']) == 'Bob met X.'

name: requires ASCII whole-word boundaries
input: whole word, embedded word, and no match
test:
assert redact_document('Alice Alice_1 Malice', ['Alice'], ['X']) == 'X Alice_1 Malice'
assert redact_document('Nothing here.', ['Alice'], ['X']) == 'Nothing here.'
